criteria_verification.notes: Independent tests collected 21 items including 20 scenario test classes plus 1 collect-only assertion test. Evidence shows all required scenario classes implemented.

Evidence describes _make_subscriber() helper creating real ForgeNotificationsSubscriber and SlackNotifier instances with only AsyncWebClient mocked. Tests drive synthetic MessageEnvelopes through real components.
Evidence confirms plain pytest only - no pytest-bdd imports, no .feature files, no @scenario decorators. All tests use standard pytest.mark.asyncio.
TestCollectOnlyCountAssertion class implemented with test_collect_only_count_matches_expected() asserting >=21 tests to prevent collection regression.
TestMalformedDrop (scenario 11) and TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop (scenario 12) verify malformed/unrecognised envelopes drop without Slack calls or exceptions.
TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation (scenario 13) mocks chat_postMessage to raise SlackApiError and verifies _handle_message() completes without propagating exception, satisfying DDR-007.
TestDuplicateTerminalDedup (scenario 10) delivers same build_complete envelope twice and verifies exactly one Slack call (first-wins) with dedup log entry.
TestThrottlingBurst (scenario 16) sends burst of 3 notifications, mocks 429 with Retry-After on first call, verifies worker pacing and retry behavior.
TestNoReplayOnRestart (scenario 18) creates subscriber, delivers notification, stops, creates new subscriber, verifies no replay - confirming in-memory posture per DDR-027.
